statement: A release-prep card that says 'run the bump script, then every edit it lists' and also 'no edit to src/' contradicts itself whenever the script's follow-up list names a src/ file: here the cross-path report pin in src/__tests__/index.test.ts moves with toolVersion, so obeying both makes the PR red on exactly that assertion. Check the mandated tool's follow-up list against every path prohibition before running it. When they collide, keep the prohibition, run the one failing test to read the measured value, verify the exact patch in a throwaway worktree outside the branch, and hand that patch back. Do not break the rule, and do not open a PR that is silently red.
